s: Din biqa shehiqqipuha nokrim ubo seip echad: shabat bebiqa vehiqqipuha nokrim beshabbat mechitztzot ledira, ap al pi shehi reshut hayyachid gemura leinyan tiltul, shekkol mechitztza hannaaset beshabbat beshogeg shemah mechitztza, vekol shekken keshennaaset al yede nokrim — ap al pi ken im hi yetera mealpayim eno yakol lehallek bah ella ad alpayim mimmaqom sheshshabat bo, sheen mechitztzot ellu moilot laasot kol haheqqep shebbetokan ked' ammot, hoil velo shabat baavir mechitztzot ellu velo qana bahen shebita, shekkesheqqiddesh alayv hayyom lo haya kan mechitztzot, velo qana az shebita ella ad alpayim. Veeno domeh lemi shehotziuhu nokrim chutz lattechum, sheen lo ella d' ammot. Umuttar letaltel bekullah al yede zeriqa, sheyyakol lizroq apillu lechutz lealpayim. Ubetok alpayim — daat ri"y betosepot sham sheen letaltel ella bed' ammot, dilinyan tiltul ki orecheh chashbinan kenipretza lemaqom haasur lah. Vedaat hatture zahab sheen zeh domeh lenipretza lemaqom haasur, kevan sheen issur betiltul chutz lealpayim ella mechamat sheeno yakol lelek lesham uletaltel, abal hattiltul beatzmo en bo issur, shehare reshut hayyachid gemura hi, velaken eno oser et maqom happarutz lo, sheyyakol lelek bo. Velaken muttar gam letaltel, kevan sheim haya yakol lelek chutz lealpayim — haya gam ken muttar letaltel mishsham. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim:
